title: Jario 09 · Ibili
subtitle: Graphic for the Hydrate & Reuse bottle line
deck: Topographic contour lines that turn into a river around a reusable bottle.
role: Individual project: concept, surface pattern and visualisation.

sections.title: Concept
paragraphs: Aimed at young adults, the pattern abstracts the contour lines of a mountain map. A blue-green palette brings the relief to life and the flowing lines read as a river running down the slopes: a metaphor for freshness, movement and hydration.

sections.title: Specification
paragraphs: A continuous pattern wraps the cylinder through 360°, designed for digital 3D printing with a textured powder-coat finish. The Ibili logo sits at the base. Print area 213.5 × 170 mm.
